name: thoth
description: Private N-of-M attestation for Midnight — a TypeScript monorepo.

scripts.compact: compact compile +0.36.1 packages/contracts/test/mocks/MockAttestation.compact packages/contracts/artifacts/mock_attestation && compact compile +0.36.1 packages/contracts/test/mocks/MockAttestationBytes.compact packages/contracts/artifacts/mock_attestation_bytes && compact compile +0.36.1 packages/contracts/test/mocks/MockAddressHash.compact packages/contracts/artifacts/mock_address_hash && compact compile +0.36.1 packages/contracts/test/mocks/MockRegistryDoubleInit.compact packages/contracts/artifacts/mock_registry_double_init
scripts.compact:no-zk: compact compile +0.36.1 --skip-zk packages/contracts/test/mocks/MockAttestation.compact packages/contracts/artifacts/mock_attestation && compact compile +0.36.1 --skip-zk packages/contracts/test/mocks/MockAttestationBytes.compact packages/contracts/artifacts/mock_attestation_bytes && compact compile +0.36.1 --skip-zk packages/contracts/test/mocks/MockAddressHash.compact packages/contracts/artifacts/mock_address_hash && compact compile +0.36.1 --skip-zk packages/contracts/test/mocks/MockRegistryDoubleInit.compact packages/contracts/artifacts/mock_registry_double_init
scripts.pretest: npm run compact:no-zk && npm run build
scripts.check: npm run check:biome && npm run check:compact
scripts.check:fix: npm run check:fix:biome && npm run check:fix:compact
